card.name: Just before a name is introduced
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right before a proper name, such as a company, product or person's name, in history-style web text about toys, cars, comics or families.

modes.label: Comma before a named child
modes.description: A comma after 'a son' or 'two sons' where the child's first name comes next.
modes.example: had a son<<,>> Charlie, the press dubbed him Little Lind

modes.label: Link before a maker or product
modes.description: A word like 'by', 'included', 'and' or 'or' that leads into a company or product name.
modes.example: Other companies that made pedal cars in the ’20s and ’30s<< included>> American National Automobiles of Toledo and Steel

card.writes: It pushes the model toward proper first names and name-like words as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the small word or comma just before a person's or brand's name is given.
